questions.question: Write a C program to check whether a given string is a palindrome or not. [10x2 = 20]
questions.solution_html: • Program to check palindrome string Program with correct logic but with errors – (8 marks) Logically correct program without errors – (10 marks) (Input – 3, Process – 5, Output – 2) #include #include int main() { char str[100]; printf("Enter a string: "); gets(str); int len = strlen(str), flag = 1; for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) { if (str!= str[len - i - 1]) { flag = 0; break; } } if (flag) printf("Palindrome"); else printf("Not a palindrome"); return 0; }
